dev.galleryjob.copy_crashed.text: the copy stopped: a file crashed the processing
dev.galleryjob.copy_crashed.note: Error shown in the share dialog when making a shared gallery (a link to some photos and videos the owner shares) failed: copying one of the files made the device's processing stop.

dev.galleryjob.copy_failed.note: Error shown in the share dialog when making a shared gallery failed: one of its files could not be copied into it. {name} is the file's name; {detail} the reason, in the system's own words (English).

dev.galleryjob.no_small_copy.text: could not make a small copy of {name}
dev.galleryjob.no_small_copy.note: Error shown in the share dialog when making a shared gallery in low resolution (only small copies of the photos are shared) failed: the small copy of one photo could not be made. {name} is the photo's name.
